phases.title: Add v14 migration with kind columns to schemas table

review_findings.message: Recorded Gate 3 command 'cargo test --test cli migrate' does not execute this phase's new test_migration_v13_to_v14: 'migrate' is not a substring of 'migration' (verified by running: the filter matches only test_migrate_command — 1 passed, 56 filtered out). The new CLI test passes when invoked by exact name, and the bin-side gate 'cargo test --bin engrams upgrade' does cover the unit v13-to-v14 test, so real coverage exists; but the recorded CLI gate reports green without ever running the phase's headline CLI addition. Same genre as spec-0002 phase 2's vacuous 'cargo test schemas' gate.

phases.title: Confirm copies kind and reasons from candidate into schema row

review_findings.message: Spec 0004 API surface announces 'schema confirm success payload: the schema object gains kind', but promote()'s schema JSON (confirm.rs:559-569) still omits kind, and no remaining phase owns confirm output (phase 3 covers prime/list/show, phase 4 export/import), so the announced contract item is currently orphaned. AC-1 itself — the stored row copies kind and reasons as-is — is met and tested. Same genre as spec-0002 phase 6's missing blended-score field.

phases.title: Project kind through prime, list, and show outputs

review_findings.message: Recorded Gate 3 command 'cargo test --test cli schemas' executes only test_prime_leads_with_schemas_block (verified by running: 1 passed, 57 filtered out) — 'schemas' is not a substring of this phase's new test_schema_confirm_payload_carries_kind (tests/cli.rs:2584) nor of test_schema_list_show_refine_and_confirm_bump, whose new kind/bump assertions therefore run in no recorded phase-3 gate. Both pass when invoked by exact name, and the bin gate 'cargo test --bin engrams schemas' covers the same contract at unit level (confirm tests assert out["schema"]["kind"]; prime_block/list unit tests assert entry kind), so real coverage exists — but the recorded CLI gate is green while exercising only the prime entry assertion. Same genre as this spec's phase-1 vacuous 'migrate' filter, which phase 3 was explicitly told to avoid.

No recorded phase-3 verification command targets the memory integration target, so s15_prime_list_show_surface_kind (tests/memory.rs:975) — the only end-to-end test of the pre-0004 'unclear'/'[]' as-is invariant across prime, list, and show — runs in zero recorded gates; even the natural 'cargo test --test memory schemas' filter would miss it by name (verified: matches only s14_export_import_preserves_schemas_with_identity_and_telemetry, 13 filtered out). The test passes when invoked by exact name, and the bin gate covers the invariant at unit level (show_includes_kind_and_parsed_reasons asserts the empty-array fallback), so this is a gate-recording gap, not missing coverage.
